confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from the RBA page: 0.6720 USD per AUD on 2026-11-18. Food and drink anchors rest on one aggregated, crowdsourced cost-of-living source (MyLifeElsewhere), which gave about $7.46 for an inexpensive meal, $2.03 for a cappuccino and $2.42 for a beer. I ran only one price search and did not search separately for mid-range meals, cocktails or wine. The mid-range meal, cocktail and wine figures are estimates scaled from the beer and inexpensive-meal prices. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. Florianópolis prices rise sharply in the January–February high season. The reference window is July 2026, which is low season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other southern Brazilian coastal and tourist cities, with Florianópolis priced somewhat above the Brazilian average. Drinks are tourist-venue prices.
